current_scope.code_execution_requirement: The user explicitly approved that School-OS agents must be able to execute code. This does not require a dedicated personal machine, persistent process or coding CLI.
current_scope.supplier_availability_report: The user reports confirmation of code execution from all major personal-agent suppliers. This report has not been independently qualified in these fixtures or this documentation update.
current_scope.code_execution_approval_limit: The earlier code-capability prerequisite alone did not choose a language. Extra dependencies, SDKs, network assumptions or new canonical architecture are not approved by implication.
current_scope.updated: 2026-09-15; written scope reconciliation only, no execution.
current_scope.deferred_post_mvp: D2 interrupted canonical-write repair, the separate records/ordinary-save framework, D7 centralized tools/jobs/capabilities register and scheduling control, and D8 package installer/upgrades/compatibility/migrations are outside MVP. Preserve original stimuli and expectations as historical/deferred where noted.
current_scope.records_framework_exception: Do not require a schema/write engine or restore minimum records/ordinary-save framework review as an MVP approval gate. Canonical Drive data, approved D1/D5 meanings, normal agent verification, source coverage and cleanup remain required. Routine implementation within approved meanings may proceed; a genuinely new canonical architecture still needs explicit approval.
current_scope.minimal_helpers: Approved small reusable Python standard-library helpers: normalize_subject, normalize_address_parts for already extracted address parts, and utf8_size. Recipes point to actual scripts; the agent and tools perform the rest. This helper authoring is not whole-project implementation or qualification.
current_scope.d4_execution_direction: One logical run completes all relevant unprocessed mail in its authorized scope. The actual agent owns adaptive resource batching and resource recovery with School-OS guidance. Former School-OS 25-message/100-listing-entry/8-MiB per-run or transfer caps and School-OS batch scheduling are rejected; D1 per-page storage limits remain approved.
current_scope.d5_approval: D5 is approved in full: substantive claims and relationships; finite/recurring tasks; separate parent fields and completion; native recurrence or next-14-day occurrence fallback with continuation; three-way task-field reconciliation; missing projections do not cancel canonical tasks. Preserve these meanings without requiring the deferred records/save framework.
current_scope.d6_direction: The agent validates uncertain actions through its available authorized means. Complete ingestion is required before an ordinary daily brief. A blocked run reports incomplete coverage and its blocker; it does not issue an ordinary partial daily brief. Remaining recency/content/audio choices are not blanket-approved, and no fixed intent/effect or records/save engine is inferred.
current_scope.d7_direction: Users and agents own nonconcurrent scheduling and choose adapters from recipes. No centralized School-OS capability/tool/job register, scheduler, schedule control or known-job query is required in MVP.
current_scope.d8_direction: D1 system/instance/extensions separation remains approved for future support. Package installer, upgrades, compatibility and migrations are deferred; minimum setup still needs a separate decision.
current_scope.still_applicable: Normal verified persistence and privacy, metadata identity, bounded source/storage access, saved-window continuation, fresh-agent queries, and the approved S30–S31 query-coverage rule remain applicable. Limited answers to questions do not override the ordinary daily-brief completion gate.
current_scope.separate_pending_decisions: Minimum setup, remaining D4 cutoff/identity choices and D6 content/audio choices remain unresolved. The separate records/save framework is deferred, not a pending MVP gate. No alternative persistence engine, new canonical architecture, central registry or batch scheduler is approved through generic delegation or these written scenarios.
current_scope.interpretation_of_continuation: Agent-managed resource continuation and source-window replay use normally verified saved state and do not promise interrupted canonical-write repair or authorize a School-OS continuation scheduler.
current_scope.historical_preservation: Scenario IDs, source cards and original given/events/expectations remain retained. Current scope notes/guidance override superseded branches; historical_scope_note and historical_approval_dependencies retain earlier wording without reinstating a deferred MVP gate. No old stimulus is execution permission.
